what: A22: an FM workstation for the FM-1. Ten synthesised engines (FM-4, ELECTRIC, STACK, ANALOG, SHAPER, WIRE, HAZE, MONO, KIT, PERC), each with eight algorithms and four live knobs, drawn in colour vector graphics. Eight effects, a four-track tape with knob automation, a mixer, Riff and Shake sequencers, an arpeggiator, a step sequencer and eight patch snapshots. Derived from h1 by Jake Handy.
